subject: [AMBER] Addendum on problems about finding CUDA

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
A better, if less-specific, version of my previous email about finding CUDA:
Anyone having problems with the cmake installation should be sure to visit
Jamie Smith's Amber-specific page:
https://ambermd.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/CMake-Guide-to-Options
The "Using CUDA" section here repeats what I said in my earlier email.  This
page also has lots of suggestions for other cmake aspects, such a MPI,
external libraries, MKL, Python, etc.)
....dac
